summary: Completed final narrow backend+frontend verification for Premium restore success marker and Continue flow, plus isolated unit tests for core.ai_gate across all three usage types.
action_items: No blocking fixes from this narrow scope.
critical_code_review_comments: `core.ai_gate` behavior matches intended gating: premium short-circuits before usage count lookup; free users receive HTTP 402 at configured limits.
Paywall restore path now surfaces deterministic success marker (`purchase-success`) with explicit `Continue` action before navigation back.
Same `restore-purchases` testID exists in profile row and paywall button; functionality is correct, but selector ambiguity can affect automation unless scoped to active screen.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for requested narrow premium restore/continue flow

context_for_next_testing_agent: Premium QA account (qa.nom.premium@example.com) remained premium throughout. Web flow verified: You -> Manage subscription -> Paywall -> Restore Purchases -> `purchase-success` + `premium-success-continue` -> back to Profile with `NomNom Premium` still active.
rca_of_issue: Prior nondeterministic completion stemmed from restore/purchase outcomes not always exposing a stable visible completion marker before navigation. Current implementation resolves this by rendering a persistent success card (`Premium is active!`) and explicit Continue action.
